svg.font-family: 'DM Sans', Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: PHP and Laravel Developer roadmap
svg.desc: 01 Language Fundamentals: Modern PHP syntax and types, Object-oriented PHP, Errors and exceptions, Composer and autoloading, Code style and static analysis; 02 The Framework: Project structure and Artisan, Request lifecycle and the service container, Routing and controllers, Middleware, Configuration and environments, Laravel AI SDK; 03 HTTP and REST APIs: REST API design, Resource routes and controllers, API resources, Status codes and headers, Filtering and pagination, API documentation with OpenAPI; 04 Databases and Data Access: Migrations, Eloquent models and relationships, Efficient queries, Data integrity and transactions, Factories and seeders, Query builder and raw SQL; 05 Validation and Error Handling: Form requests and validation rules, Error response format, Exception handling, Logging; 06 Authentication and Authorization: Password storage, API tokens with Sanctum, Cookie sign-in for single-page apps, Policies and gates, Rate limiting sign-in; 07 Background Jobs and Caching: Queues and jobs, Events, notifications and mail, Task scheduling, Caching, Horizon; 08 Testing: Feature tests, Database testing, Fakes and mocks, Contract tests and static analysis, Mutation testing; 09 Security and Performance: Mass assignment and injection, CORS and security headers, The security audit checklist, Query performance and indexes, Load testing, Octane; 10 Deployment and Operations: Production configuration, Docker images, CI/CD pipelines, Production database migrations, Workers and the scheduler in production, Health checks and monitoring
svg.text: Request lifecycle and the service container
Workers and the scheduler in production
